cases: order_id present in a tool output                  -> PASS (no deny)
user_id stated only by the customer                -> DENY  (corpus_roles=['tool'], = L10)
same user_id present in an auth tool output        -> PASS
negative control: undeclared arg absent from corpus-> PASS (not blocked) [[57]]
negative control: undeclared tool                  -> PASS (not touched) [[57]]
item_ids fabricated, everything else grounded      -> PASS  <-- see below
_isolation_probe_._case_8_is_the_evidence_for_a_gate3_reje: case 8 is the empirical proof of the G3-LIST-ARG-NOT-RESOLVED rejection (ledger G03/G04/G12/G13/G29). The call carries a fabricated item_ids and nothing else wrong, and the engine does not deny. Had item_ids been adopted into grounded_args it would have been a dead declaration - A2 volume with zero delivery, which is exactly the failure this experiment is measuring.
_isolation_probe_._note_: This proves the declarations fire in isolation. It does NOT prove they fire in the live run, and it says nothing about reward ([[85]], [[69]]). T2_WRITE_ARG_GROUND=1 is already exported by go_stack.sh:227,388, so the flag half of [[81]] is satisfied for this contract - unlike the two contracts that adopted nothing (T2_WRITE_ARG_ENUM absent from go_stack.sh; T2_DUP_WRITE=0 at go_stack.sh:695).

_amend_gates_._why_this_is_not_a_mergeable_key_: gates is a LIST. Emitting a `gates` key here would REPLACE all 8 live retail gates on merge. edit_2.note: checks[0] is the allow=['pending'] check with resolver_path [order_id, get_order_details, status]

sources.quote: An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.

_amend_gates_._gate_1_: PASS - L96 is verbatim and its section heading (L94 '## Modify pending order') plus L98 name shipping address and payment method as the modifications it governs.
_amend_gates_._gate_2_: PASS - both tools are in the 16-tool inventory and mutates=True.
_amend_gates_._gate_3_: PASS - no new checker. The check shape already exists and is pure set membership: resolve_field([order_id, get_order_details, status]) then `cur in ['pending']` (gate_interpreter.py:392-407). Unresolvable -> `continue` = fail-open.
_amend_gates_._contradicts_: a2/retail.settings.json G5._note says verbatim: 'address/payment 도구는 status-무관→제외=false-block 회피'. That claim is contradicted by L96 read together with L98. Disclosing rather than silently overwriting ([[70]]): the exclusion was a false-block hedge, and the hedge costs the two writes that L96 covers. Counter-evidence I could not obtain: whether the retail env itself already rejects these two writes on a non-pending order - that needs a tool return value and the path to those is results.json.gz, which carries evaluation_criteria ([[23]]), so it was not opened.
_amend_gates_._sign_to_count_: [POLICY GATE G5_STATUS_PRECONDITION] denies on these two tool names. If the count is 0 at first ignition the wiring is wrong, not the rule ([[81]]).

_rejection_ledger_.why: DEAD DECLARATION - shape mismatch with the consumer. Both consumers of `write_arg_enum` read the value out of a NESTED dispatcher payload: t2_gate_patch.py:12026 `_ia = _ad.get("arguments")` and t2_gate_patch.py:3390 `inner = outer.get("arguments")`. A direct call cancel_pending_order(order_id=..., reason=...) has no 'arguments' key, so _ia == {} -> _val == '' -> `if not (_val and _grp and _names): continue` (fail-open). retail has discoverable_user_tools == [] and user_tools == [] : there is no dispatcher, so this contract cannot fire on ANY retail tool. Second, independent kill: the block is gated on `os.environ.get("T2_WRITE_ARG_ENUM")=="1"` and T2_WRITE_ARG_ENUM does not appear in go_stack.sh at all ([[81]]).
_rejection_ledger_.named_fix: engine-side: the consumer would have to fall back to the outer args dict when no nested 'arguments' payload exists. That is an engine edit -> out of scope for this authoring pass ([[05]]/[[58]]).
